description:
`extract_quad_hi` in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/gf2m_batch.rs` is unused and compiled under `#[allow(dead_code)]`. It serves degrees $m \in (32, 64]$, which the batch kernel does not support.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The helper is removed, or the batch kernel supports $m \in (32, 64]$ through it with field-law coverage for those degrees.
- [hard] REQ-02: No `#[allow(dead_code)]` remains on the kernel's helpers.
title: Dead extract_quad_hi helper in the GF(2^m) batch kernel
